title: Parser Envelope (005)
description: Common output wrapper for any parser. The orchestrator validates only these fields; model — parser zone.

parser_id.description: Module identifier from parsers/*/manifest.json (typescript, csharp, compose, openapi, …)

schema_version.description: Version native JSON inside model; adapter ingest selected by parser_id + schema_version

analysis_run_id.description: FK → AnalysisRun (005); all nodes/edges ingest bound to this run

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC; generation moment envelope parser

files_analyzed.description: POSIX-relative paths working_copy_root, processed by this parser run

model.description: Native extract; schema — one of native-*.schema.json by parser_id and schema_version
